flags.name: api-version
flags.description: API generation v1 or v2; precedence: explicit flag > PLANE_CLI_API_VERSION > selected connection > v2 default

flags.name: count
flags.description: Set to `false` to skip the `COUNT(*)` query behind `total_count`. The response then leaves out `total_count`.

flags.name: offset
flags.description: Number of rows to skip from the start of the result set.

flags.name: order-by
flags.description: Field to sort the list by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, for example `-created_at`. Orders on computed fields sort by their logical order and use the default offset pagination.

flags.name: paginate
flags.description: Set to `cursor` to switch to the keyset cursor envelope, which skips the `COUNT` query and is better for paging deep into a list. Leave it out to get the default offset envelope with `total_count`. One of `cursor`.

flags.name: status-in
flags.description: Filter by several triage statuses, separated by commas. Takes the same values as `status`.

flags.name: fields
flags.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Fields you don't request are left out of each row instead of coming back as `null`. `id` is always included. Pass `all` to get every requestable field. An unknown field name returns `400` with the list of valid names, so a typo is caught instead of being silently ignored. See [Sparse fields](/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields). Requestable here: `created_at`, `created_by_id`, `description_html`, `duplicate_to_id`, `external_id`, `external_source`, `id`, `intake_id`, `name`, `priority`, `snoozed_till`, `source`, `source_email`, `state_id`, `status`, `updated_at`, `updated_by_id`, `work_item_id`.

flags.description: API generation v1 or v2; precedence: explicit flag > PLANE_CLI_API_VERSION > selected connection > v2 default

flags.name: cursor
flags.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

flags.name: expand
flags.description: Comma-separated list of related fields to expand in the response.

flags.name: fields
flags.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

flags.name: per-page
flags.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.
